articles.title: Nia Therapeutics Publishes Peer-Reviewed Validation of a 60-Channel Brain Implant for Closed-Loop Neurostimulation
articles.mainIdea: Nia Therapeutics Publishes Peer-Reviewed Validation of a 60-Channel Brain Implant for Closed-Loop Neurostimulation
articles.summary: Business Wire: Nia Therapeutics Publishes Peer-Reviewed Validation of a 60-Channel Brain Implant for Closed-Loop Neurostimulation. ALLSTON, Mass., January 04, 2026--Nia Therapeutics announced publication in Brain Stimulation of the first in vivo validation of its Smart Neurostimulation System (SNS), a wireless, implantable brain-computer interface designed for closed-loop treatment of memory disorders.
